question:
A hollow spherical shell is made of a metal of density 28 g/cm³. Its internal and external radii are 2 cm and 5 cm, respectively. What is the approximate weight (in kg) of the shell?

(Take pi = (22)/(7), Density = (Mass)/(Volume)
solution:
**Given:**

Density of metal = 28 g/cm³

Internal radius (r₁) = 2 cm

External radius (r₂) = 5 cm

**Formula used:**

Density = Mass ÷ Volume

Volume of a sphere = (4/3)πr³

Volume of shell = Volume of external sphere - Volume of internal sphere

Weight = Mass ÷ 1000 (to convert grams to kilograms)

**Calculation:**

Volume of external sphere = (4/3)πr₂³
